summary.intent: Make the CI 'Real Tool Tests' job skip reinstalling tools (already installed or restored from cache by the action) by running tests with `just --no-deps test-real-tools`, while keeping the dependency for local use. This was requested by a peer Claude session.
summary.outcome: Verified `--no-deps` works with the installed just version (dry run showed no npm install commands), changed the workflow step in callisto-ci.yml, and committed it. Push and the report back to the peer were not confirmed in the transcript, and the results of workflow-contracts and doc-check were not clearly reported.

repo: The 'Real Tool Tests' job in .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml ran `just test-real-tools`, which depends on install-real-tools; the install action already installs or restores the tools, so the dependency is redundant in CI.
The repo has `just workflow-contracts` and `just doc-check` recipes used as validation gates after workflow edits.

code.finding: Step `run: just test-real-tools` changed to `run: just --no-deps test-real-tools` so CI skips the reinstall while local runs keep the recipe dependency.

workflow: Use `just --no-deps --dry-run <recipe>` and grep the output to confirm a dependency is skipped before changing CI.
The `rtk` prefix wrapper is used for some commands; the first grep attempt piped incorrectly and had to be re-run with `rtk grep` after the pipe.
Edit with `sed -i ''` on macOS (BSD sed) requires the empty backup suffix.

friction: The first verification command was run with plain `grep` on the left of the pipe and was re-issued with `rtk grep`, wasting a call.
The exit codes (wc=, dc=) of workflow-contracts and doc-check were not shown in the transcript, so passing status is unverified.
The working directory is not a git repository, per the environment, yet a git commit was attempted; its outcome was not shown.
open_items: Confirm the commit succeeded and push it; the push was not run in the transcript.
Confirm workflow-contracts and doc-check passed (wc=0, dc=0).
Report results back to the peer session 'close-gap-for-alpha'.
The fallback (make install-real-tools skip tools already at the pinned version) was not needed but remains an option.
